about: Hard documents (#1067): real source lines that every change to the taxonomy, the fold rules, the category guard or the publish-time same-line check must still read the same way. Replayed in CI by src/lib/agents/deming/hard-documents.test.ts, with no database and no model calls. Each case cites its stored document (source_documents.id) and the text it was read from: agent_source_texts.text_hash, plus agent_source_text_id where the excerpt was cut from that text, otherwise Knox's quoted excerpt of the line. Read from production, read-only, on 2026-10-14.

near_name.about: Live rows of one document, category and amount under near names (#1302): a plural, punctuation, a trailing "fee", or one qualifier word in front. The duplicate collapse (nearNameRepeats) closes the copies the page prints as one line and keeps the copy named by `kept`; a pair the page prints as two lines at the price stays two fees. Rows are live fees as stored on 2026-10-14. `text_of` names the same_price case whose text the rows were read from.
